status: registered before first policy evaluation; no parameter search
source: pinned BTC archive; data/sessions-v2/manifest.json freezes entire chronological windows before validity rules
parent_cap: max100 shares AND <=1% initial observed min(bid,ask) top-ten depth; tested sizes0.25 and1share
benchmark: initial captured midpoint; exact twice-money signed shortfall includes fees and fixed unfilled penalty
fees: hypothetical constant research scenarios; not actual Polymarket dynamic fee schedule
eligibility: start at first valid S; require source coverage through start+deadline+1s; no valid initial book or cap failure is retained exclusion; all policies share eligibility
ordinary_stress: initial spread >= development75thpercentile is descriptively wide-spread; threshold fixed from development prefixes, not outcome costs
uncertainty: paired session-window differences, deterministic percentile bootstrap1000 resamples of whole windows; windows correlated on one day; not independent day-level or selection-corrected inference
stability: for each policy pair/side/size/deadline, compare session-mean differences by scenario; stable if sign consistent, reversal if sign switches, unresolved if any bootstrap interval spanszero
attempt_registry: retain every policy/scenario/order combination or exact exclusion; no tuning after confirmation is observed
